title: Two nights on Cat Ba
pace: One boat day, one park morning
summary: Night on the Cát Bà harbor, a Lan Ha boat from Bến Bèo, and a morning inside the national park gate. The December 2022 hire is printed as 3–4 hours and also as an 8-hour day.

days.title: Day 1 — Harbor and Lan Ha
days.body: Sleep above the seawall. The boat leaves Bến Bèo. The park’s 19 December 2022 account describes a 3–4 hour hire and also names an 8-hour day. Bay tickets from 1 January 2026 are 120,000 đồng for an adult and 60,000 for a child from 6 on the 2025 article. The 2024 child line also uses 1.2 m. Boat hire is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 2 — The park gate
days.body: The park’s own fee page prints 07:00–17:00 and does not print the amounts. The 20 December 2025 article prices the park at 160,000 đồng for an adult and 80,000 for a child from 6. Under 6 is free. The 2024 text uses the same prices and a different retention line, and it adds the 1.2 m child test. A road minute from the harbor is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Lan Ha Bay
stops.note: The 19 December 2022 account prints a 3–4 hour hire from Bến Bèo and also an 8-hour day. 240 minutes is the 4-hour end of that hire, not a single official duration. Boat hire is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Cat Ba National Park
stops.note: A posted visit length is Check on arrival. 180 minutes is a morning on this plan, not a gate figure. The gate is 07:00–17:00. The Việt Hải trek is titled 12 km, and the 11 November 2023 account also says more than 8 km and 8 km.

seoTitle: Cat Ba in two nights — Lan Ha, then the park
seoDescription: Two nights on the Cat Ba harbor: a Lan Ha boat from Ben Beo, printed as 3–4 hours and as an 8-hour day, then the national park gate at 07:00–17:00.
